svg.title: Ichor Portal Station — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A simplified, recognizable brass portal station based on the supplied references: ornate circular arch, cyan energy opening, side consoles, lamps, and approach steps. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
